scan_warning: Currently, image/media analysis is running in the background, so tag editing/merging is temporarily locked.
no_name_ja_help: No Japanese name is set. Similar-media search falls back to the English name, which can reduce accuracy.
screen_help:
Tags are generated automatically during media analysis, so tags with the same meaning pile up under different names (e.g. cup / cups / coffee_cup). On this screen you can consolidate them into one, or replace them with a new tag.

Consolidating makes related media easier to surface in search and tag filtering.
In exchange, the fine distinctions between those tags are lost, so tag variety goes down.

Consolidation cannot be undone. Check the targets before applying.
guide_all: Rename tags, or select two or more and consolidate them manually
guide_all_help:
・Clicking a tag name or the filter icon filters the gallery by that tag (this screen closes)
・The eye icon shows the media carrying that tag
・The pencil icon edits the English and Japanese names
・Tick two or more and a "Selected" box appears above. Pick the tag to keep from the dropdown, then press "Consolidate manually"
・Tags with no Japanese name are less accurate in similar-media search
guide_proposals: AI looks for consolidation candidates. Pick only the good ones and apply
guide_proposals_help:
Only approved suggestions are applied.
・Tags you want out of a group can be excluded individually
・Rejecting removes the suggestion from the list after 3 seconds.

There are three ways to look for candidates, and results are stored separately per method (switching does not require re-running).

・Spelling variants … rules only (spelling, singular/plural, Japanese notation). Instant
・Hypernyms … AI decides "is a kind of" and groups them. Takes minutes
・Close in meaning … embedding similarity. Not necessarily synonyms

・If a suggestion contains an unrelated tag, exclude it from the consolidation individually.
To consolidate a suggested group into a brand-new tag, set the tag to keep to "Enter my own" and type the English and Japanese names.

Work left over from an interrupted run, tags added since the run, and chunks that failed are all counted together as "not looked at yet". "Continue" picks up all of them, so there is no separate action for re-running only the failures.
proposals_empty_body: Press "Scan Similar Tags" to look for spelling variants, singular/plural forms and tags close in meaning, and list them as consolidation candidates.
reject_hint: Removes it from the suggestion list. You can cancel within 3 seconds.

All saved judgements will be discarded and rebuilt from scratch.
Hypernym extraction runs again, so this takes several minutes.
